entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so... hard to use. The whole interface feels very confusing to me, even after I read the user manual twice. I really expected more from it, especially for the price.

I understand. It can be frustrating when a new device doesn't feel intuitive right away. Let me just pull up your account here... I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, so about 20 days ago. Is that correct?

Yes, that's right. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I saved up for this. I feel so silly now. I really needed this money for other things, and I just feel awful that I spent it on something I can't even use properly.

Please don't feel that way. Let me check our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see it right here. Our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they're in the original condition.
Oh, really? So I can return it?
Absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. You have no idea how much I appreciate that. You've really helped me out.

Of course, I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just place the sensor back in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
I will do that this afternoon. Thank you again, you've completely turned my day around.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
